t: How word travels from the Throne downward
a: إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا سَبَّحَ لَهُ حَمَلَةُ الْعَرْشِ ثُمَّ سَبَّحَ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ
p: Idhā qaḍā amran sabbaḥa lahu ḥamalatu-l-ʿarsh, thumma sabbaḥa ahlu-s-samāʾi-lladhīna yalūnahum, thumma-lladhīna yalūnahum
m: When He decrees a matter, the bearers of the Throne glorify Him, then the inhabitants of the heaven next to them, then those next to them.
